dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Lions (8-2) Week 12 Briefing: Thursday Injury Report Ahead of Bears
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: S Chuck Clark (hamstring) logged limited practice reps Thursday [Dave Birkett](https://bsky.app/profile/davebirkett.bsky.social/post/3n33et46nq222). DT Skyler Gill-Howard (knee), CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. (shoulder), and LB DJ Wonnum (back) did not practice Thursday, while CB D.J. Reed (hip) and TE Sam LaPorta (ankle) practiced in full [Erik Schlitt](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/detroit-lions-injuries/182466/lions-bears-week-12-injury-report-sam-laporta-chuck-clark-upgraded-on-tuesday).

Week 12 Bears Outlook: Dan Campbell and DC Kelvin Sheppard open installation for the Chicago Bears (8-2, CHI -1.5, HC Ben Johnson, OC Press Taylor & DC Dennis Allen (Ford Field))—a unit ranked #3 in Rushing Yards / Game (142.4 yds) as Detroit prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-thanksgiving-preview-2026-chicago-bears-vs-detroit-lions) [Jeremy Reisman](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/detroit-lions-analysis/182546/detroit-lions-vs-chicago-bears-preview-prediction-on-paper).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 8-2 (1st in NFC North • #2 Seed in NFC), Detroit carries a 91.9% postseason projection, 46% NFC North division title mark, and 18.8% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-thanksgiving-preview-2026-chicago-bears-vs-detroit-lions).
Around the Beat: Jahmyr Gibbs and Chuba Hubbard have been a cut above [PFF](https://x.com/PFF/status/2125681059723686232).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Detroit ranks #5 in Points / Game (28.8), #15 in Points Allowed / Game (22.0), #15 in Turnover Differential (+2), giving Dan Campbell and Kelvin Sheppard a clear benchmark ahead of Thu, Nov 26, 1:00 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Chicago Bears [Jeremy Reisman](https://www.prideofdetroit.com/detroit-lions-analysis/182546/detroit-lions-vs-chicago-bears-preview-prediction-on-paper).
